svg.title: PTAP architecture and instruction routing
svg.desc: The jtag_ptap module. client_tap_ctrl_i clocks the TAP controller u_jtag_tap_ctrlr, whose TRST is ANDed with pwr_on_rst_ni in u_trst_n_and; the controller forwards TCK, TMS and the combined TRST on host_tap_ctrl_o, drives client_tdo_oen_o, and passes IR and DR scan control to the scan registers and, ORed together, to stap_host_scan_ctrl_o. The optional TMP controller u_jtag_tmp returns persistence_mode to the TAP controller. client_tdi_i feeds the 6-bit instruction register u_jtag_inst_reg and every test data register. The instruction register captures 000001, decodes its opcode one-hot onto inst_decoded_o[63:0], and the decoded opcode selects one register: BYPASS for 00, 07, 08, 0A, 0B, 3F and every opcode without its own register, INV_BYPASS for 3E, IDCODE for 01, TAP_3DCR for 0E, TMP_STATUS for 0C, IC_RESET for 0D, DEBUG_CONTROL for 18, JTAG_CAPS for 19, the three JTAG2AXI_CAPS registers for 1B, 21 and 27, the SMC OTP, SEP OTP and SMC fabric jtag2axi bridges for 1C to 20, 22 to 26 and 28 to 2C, the external boundary-scan chain for 03 to 06 and 09 and the external iJTAG network for 1A and 02. Optional registers and bridges are dashed. The bridges drive AXI-Lite to the SMC and SEP OTP and AXI4 to the SMC fabric, each blocked by its own security_disable_i input. tdr_mux selects the instruction register during an IR scan and the selected register otherwise. u_zlb_tdr_mux substitutes client_tdi_i for ZERO_LENGTH_BYPASS (3D) during a DR scan; its output leaves as stap_host_scan_out_o. u_tdo_mux substitutes the STAP chain return stap_host_scan_in_i while the 3DCR select bit is set. The result is retimed on the falling TCK edge, and u_tdo_bypass_mux bypasses the retimer for ZERO_LENGTH_BYPASS before client_tdo_o.
svg.text: u_tdo_mux: STAP chain return while stap_select (TAP_3DCR)
u_tdo_bypass_mux: skips the retimer for ZERO_LENGTH_BYPASS
